title: DOQS instance module declaration
description: The [instance] table of an okh.toml in a CONSUMER repository. A Git submodule is a frozen mirror with no slot for the consumer's own choices, so the choice of family variant lives here instead — in the consumer's own folder, in text, next to the resolved parameters and resolved BOM that doqs/scripts/resolve_instance.py generates from it.

family.description: Repo-root-relative path of the family submodule, e.g. modules/linear-stage.

composition.description: Family-root-relative path of the chosen composition module.

model.description: Parametric model slug declared by the composition's core module.

sku.description: Optional commercial id joining the family's catalog.toml.

params.description: Optional instance-local sparse parameter override, applied on top of the model.
